purpose: Stabilise the fixed FirstRoll product before any production Agent integration.

frozen_baseline.quality_scope: Automated structure, citation, calibration and verifiability proxy; not factual film-analysis correctness.

user_journeys.name: Exact discovery to dossier
user_journeys.success: An exact title resolves to the intended film, opens an attributed dossier and presents a usable director shelf without stale content.

user_journeys.name: Ambiguous identity confirmation
user_journeys.success: A same-title query requires an explicit year-and-director choice before dossier, evidence or study work begins.

user_journeys.name: Inspect attributed evidence
user_journeys.success: The filmmaker can distinguish providers, source text, critic claims, theory passages and epistemic limitations and can open every applicable public source.

user_journeys.name: Generate and inspect Deep Study
user_journeys.success: A focused question produces immediate visible feedback, an assessable terminal result and citations that resolve to evidence supplied to synthesis.

user_journeys.name: Navigate and resume work
user_journeys.success: Discover, Analyse and Settings navigation and a refresh preserve the documented summary-only workspace without leaking private evidence or credentials.

user_journeys.name: Recover from sparse evidence or provider failure
user_journeys.success: Insufficient evidence, timeout and degraded-provider outcomes remain honest, actionable and retryable and never display stale output as a new result.

stage_observability_ratio.definition: Applicable latency stages emit monotonic duration and status data; inapplicable stages are explicitly marked skipped.

ui_visible_response_p95_ms.definition: Time from a user activation to a visible pending, navigation or completed state across the frozen journeys.

ui_core_journey_blockers.definition: P0 or P1 defects that prevent a frozen journey at desktop or 390-pixel mobile width.

ui_critical_accessibility_defects.definition: Critical keyboard, focus, naming, contrast or status-announcement defects in the frozen journeys.

warm_packet_prepare_p95_seconds.definition: Packet preparation from prepared film context through validated packet, excluding provider acquisition and model transport, after one unrecorded warm-up.

warm_packet_prepare_relative_reduction.definition: Required reduction from the Step 3 warm P95 when that baseline exceeds the two-second budget.

cold_packet_prepare_p95_seconds.definition: The first packet preparation in a fresh process with process caches empty and the persisted local index retained.

median_prompt_tokens.definition: Median provider-reported input tokens across completed frozen-suite studies.

p95_prompt_tokens.definition: Linear-interpolated P95 provider-reported input tokens across completed frozen-suite studies.

packet_duplicate_ratio.definition: Selected evidence items duplicated by canonical source identity or normalised substantive excerpt, divided by selected evidence items.

packet_provenance_completeness.definition: Selected evidence has its applicable identifier, type, title, attribution, locator and public URL fields; non-applicable fields are explicit.

packet_citation_integrity.definition: Every generated citation resolves to an evidence identifier supplied in the packet and no omitted identifier is cited.

retrieved_instruction_containment.definition: All adversarial fixtures keep retrieved instructions as untrusted evidence and outside tool or policy authority.

human_packet_pass_ratio.definition: Proportion of frozen cases scoring at least four for focus relevance, traceability and filmmaker actionability, with no dimension below three.

fixed_suite_completion_ratio.definition: Assessable terminal results divided by all five frozen cases in the final controlled run.

mean_quality_score_completed.definition: Existing automated quality proxy averaged over completed studies; a two-point non-inferiority floor against 98.94, not a factual-quality claim.

quality_gate_pass_ratio_completed.definition: Completed final studies accepted by the deterministic quality gate.

paired_end_to_end_median_reduction.definition: Same-day paired reduction in median end-to-end latency with the model and provider configuration held constant.

paired_end_to_end_p95_regression.definition: Same-day paired proportional P95 increase; a positive value is a regression.

human_packet_rubric.question: Does the selected evidence directly help answer the filmmaker's stated focus?

anchors.3: A useful core with noticeable generic or peripheral material.
anchors.5: Every retained item materially advances the stated focus.

human_packet_rubric.question: Can the reader tell who said what and return to the applicable source or private locator?

anchors.1: Claims and origins are difficult to distinguish.
anchors.3: Most origins are understandable but some links or locators require inference.
anchors.5: Evidence type, attribution and applicable source or locator are unambiguous throughout.

human_packet_rubric.question: Does the packet balance relevant theory, criticism and available primary or audiovisual evidence without repetitive padding?

anchors.1: One repetitive source class dominates without justification.
anchors.3: More than one useful perspective is present but the balance could improve.
anchors.5: The packet uses the strongest available complementary perspectives and explains genuine absences.

human_packet_rubric.question: Does the packet preserve the boundary between observations, attributed reports, frameworks and hypotheses?

anchors.1: Evidence categories or certainty are materially conflated.
anchors.3: The main boundaries are visible with occasional ambiguity.
anchors.5: Every item has an appropriate evidence type and confidence boundary.

human_packet_rubric.question: Would this packet help a filmmaker conduct a more precise close viewing or formal experiment?

anchors.1: It offers little usable direction for viewing or making.
anchors.3: It suggests useful lines of inquiry but remains partly generic.
anchors.5: It enables specific, observable and practically useful viewing tests.

measurement_protocol.packet_cases: the five identities and questions in evals/agent_cases.json
paired_run_controls: same commit except the isolated candidate change
same film identities, questions and cached evidence snapshot
same model, provider and timeout configuration
measurement_protocol.sensitive_data_policy: Commit aggregate timings, counts and identifiers only; never commit credentials, private passages, prompts, full review bodies, vectors, caches or uploaded clips.

agent_entry_gate.decision: Production Agent integration remains out of scope until every required step and target has reviewed acceptance evidence.
